verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS automation platform that also ships a CLI and SDK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out, or related privacy controls. SOC 2 and workspace governance claims are adjacent security features and do not count as a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
